title: Bank balance-sheet deposits canonicalized in pipeline source artifacts
points: Canonical label `deposits_and_other_accounts` was migrated to `deposits` for selected bank tickers in pipeline-generated statement artifacts (extracted markdown, JSON dumps, and flat balance-sheet rows).

D1 propagation is complete using deduplicating scoped pushes: each bank ticker was re-uploaded with `pipeline/13_d1_push.py --type bs --ticker <TICKER>`, which deletes existing `balance_sheet` rows for that ticker before re-inserting normalized rows.
D1 now has zero remaining `deposits_and_other_accounts` rows for the scoped bank tickers and no duplicate `ticker+statement_type+period_end+section+canonical` rows for `deposits` in sampled checks.
